name: Claude-BugHunter
title_zh: 把 681 份真实漏洞报告变成你的红队直觉
tagline_zh: 82 个技能 + 15 条斜杠命令，覆盖 24 类核心漏洞。不是教你原理，是直接给你别人踩过的坑和打法。
tagline_en: 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 24 vuln classes. Skip the theory—get the exact attack patterns from 681 real.
desc_en: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
why_zh: 它把公开漏洞报告按攻击链重组，不是零散 CVE 列表。每个模式都带上下文和前置条件。
why_en: It re-mines disclosed reports into attack-chain-ready patterns with context and preconditions—like a veteran red-teamer.
limit_zh: 只覆盖外部红队与漏洞狩猎场景，不含内网横向或社工。需要 Claude Code 环境；681 个模式是快照。
limit_en: External red-team & bug bounty only—no post-exploitation or social engineering. Requires Claude Code; patterns frozen at 681, post-2024 vulns are on.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
